betaDescription:
Rillora helps you keep a private map of important accounts, documents and practical directions, and choose what each trusted person can see.

This is a restricted internal release-acceptance build. Sign-in is limited to the existing enrolled test accounts. Use synthetic planning information only; do not enter passwords, complete recovery phrases or credentials that can move money.

Please check account sign-in and return, creating and editing matters, recipient views and revocation, and the supported Start Here and backup paths. Apple Sandbox purchase and restore require the designated validation account and an eligible Apple test session. Public customer access and live billing are not enabled.

Rillora does not create a legally effective will, determine death or transfer ownership.
buildTestNotes:
Restricted internal acceptance build 1.0 (2). Use only the existing authorized test accounts and synthetic records. Review access expires on 6 October 2026 at 17:08:57 UTC.

1. Sign in through the hosted flow and personally complete any required account terms. Confirm Web and iOS show the same synthetic matter.
2. Check selected recipient fields, scope reductions and revocation; the recipient must lose access without receiving hidden notes.
3. Check supported Start Here/backup flows and same-account reauthentication. Use a deliberately disposable test identity for deletion.
4. When device testing resumes, use the designated Apple Sandbox validation account to test purchase, restore and subsequent lifecycle status. No live payment or public signup is enabled.

Physical-device acceptance, export compliance and final release declarations remain separate gates. Report issues through the existing support contact without including passwords, recovery links or private map contents.
